description: This PHP script initializes and handles the display of a requirement specification revision within a testing management web application, managing user sessions, permissions, and rendering templates related to requirement revisions.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard class used for data objects

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering web pages

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes argument parameters for the request, including session variables and input parameters.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI components, retrieves requirement revision info, and prepares data for display.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for viewing or modifying requirement specifications.
